name: Incident — Security Breach (3 Days)
description: A 3-day incident response template for a confirmed security breach — unauthorized access, data leak, or account compromise. Covers containment, investigation, remediation, and stakeholder communication. Suitable as a starting point for security teams.

groups.name: Management
groups.description: Senior management, legal, HR if needed

events.title: BREACH CONFIRMED
events.description: Unauthorized access or data exposure confirmed. Document initial indicators.

events.title: Incident Commander Assigned
events.description: IC takes charge. Establishes command structure and communication channels.

events.title: Immediate Containment
events.description: Isolate affected systems, disable compromised accounts, block attacker access.

events.title: Management Notification
events.description: Brief senior management on confirmed breach, initial scope, and response actions.

events.title: Evidence Preservation
events.description: Capture forensic images, preserve logs, and secure evidence chain of custody.

events.title: SITREP #1
events.description: First formal situation report: what happened, what was contained, next steps.

events.title: Day 1 — Forensic Investigation Begins
events.description: Deep analysis of attack vector, scope of access, data affected.

events.title: Day 1 — Decision: External Notification
events.description: Decide if customers, regulators, or law enforcement need to be notified.

events.title: Day 2 Morning — Status Briefing
events.description: Update all stakeholders on investigation findings and containment status.

events.title: Day 2 — Investigation Continues
events.description: Continue forensic analysis. Map full extent of compromise.

events.title: Day 2 — SITREP #2
events.description: Second formal situation report with updated findings and timeline.

events.title: Day 3 — Remediation Actions
events.description: Patch vulnerabilities, reset credentials, harden configurations, restore systems.

events.title: Day 3 — Verification Testing
events.description: Verify all remediation actions effective. Run security scans.

events.title: Day 3 — Post-Incident Review
events.description: Review full timeline, root cause, response effectiveness, and improvements.

events.title: INCIDENT CLOSED
events.description: Incident formally closed. Lessons learned documented. Improvement actions assigned.
